text:
Type: adjustable white and grey desk lamp
Use: directed task light for reading and working at a desk; home office, study, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, retro
Materials: white plastic shade, silver-grey painted metal jointed arms and base, white cord
Colors: white, light silver grey
Shape: rounded bucket shade on a curved yoke, two-part jointed arm with hinges, round flat base, angular and light, compact
Feel: friendly, practical, crisp, tidy
Goes with: white or light wood desks, grey accents, pale walls; Scandinavian or contemporary home offices

product.name: SVIRVEL
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm and head are adjustable.
